item.title: August 20, 2026 - Facing death
item.description: Page 242. "Often we have to face some type of crisis during our recovery, such as the death of a loved one..." Just for Today: I will accept the loss of one I love and turn to my Higher Power for the strength to accept my feelings. I will make the most of my love for those in my life today.
